task_instance: Audit a single Apple App Store listing (fictional indie app 'TidyList - Task Planner') for App Store Optimization: score all 6 SKILL.md dimensions (Title & Subtitle, Description, Visual Assets, Ratings & Reviews, Metadata & Freshness, Conversion Signals), classify brand-maturity tier, compute the weighted 0-100 score/grade, and produce the full Phase 4 report (score card, top 3 quick wins, detailed findings, keyword suggestions, visual asset recommendations, priority action plan).
blocker_detail: The skill's normal Phase 1 step (WebFetch of a live App Store/Google Play URL plus a page screenshot for visual assessment) is impossible on this air-gapped workstation and would be 'missing_tool_in_runtime'/'network_or_service_unavailable' if attempted. This was not worked around with any network access; instead, the skill's own documented fallback was used ('If WebFetch returns incomplete data... Ask the user to paste missing fields if critical') by supplying a realistic pasted-listing-data input file, which let the actual analytical core of the skill (scoring, tiering, checklist flags, keyword suggestions, and report generation) run and be verified end-to-end offline.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/coreyhaines31__marketingskills__aso@offline-workstation. Created listing_input.md (simulated pasted listing fields for a Challenger-tier app, standing in for live-fetched data per the skill's own fallback). Wrote score.py implementing the Phase 2 weighted-scoring formula from SKILL.md (weights: Title&Subtitle 20%, Description 15%, Visual Assets 25%, Ratings&Reviews 20%, Metadata&Freshness 10%, Conversion Signals 10%) and ran it with `python3 score.py`, producing: Title&Subtitle 4/10, Description 5/10, Visual Assets 3/10, Ratings&Reviews 6/10, Metadata&Freshness 5/10, Conversion Signals 6/10 -> weighted final score 46.0/100, Grade D (matches the 30-49=D band in SKILL.md's Score interpretation table). Wrote aso_audit_tidylist.md (158 lines) containing the full Phase 4 report: score card, top 3 quick wins with concrete before/after copy and character counts, per-dimension detailed findings applying the Phase 1.5 Challenger-tier rules and the Common Issues Checklist (flagged: title wastes chars on brand only, <5 screenshots, no screenshot captions, no preview video, last update >3 months, no in-app events, no dev response to negative review), keyword suggestions with rationale, visual asset recommendations, a priority action plan table, and an explicit 'what cannot be assessed without paid tools' section (search volume/rankings) plus a note that Phase 3 competitor comparison was correctly skipped rather than fabricated since no competitor URLs or network access were available. Verified deliverable by inspecting file contents (cat/wc -l) and confirming the report's score card numbers match score.py's computed output.
